messages:
Priya Menon: Heads-up  onsite candidate next Mon (Jun 30) with a small child. Candidate requested a private waiting spot for the child + a nearby quiet room for interview due to pickup constraints. Can Facilities/Security/Cafe confirm? :raising_hand:

Kelsey Ortiz: Thanks Priya. Candidate: Maya Chen, +1-650-555-0183. ETA 09:25 (driving). Needs a short interview window (max 90m total) because child pickup at 11:00. Requests a place for caregiver to wait (soft seating, kid-friendly). Any dietary needs?

Priya Menon: Maya is fine with vegetarian snacks. Caregiver will be on-site and may need a fold-out crib/pack-n-play near the waiting area. Also requested low-scent cleaning products and an aisle cleared for stroller.

Facilities Bot: Confirmed: Quiet Room F (4th floor) reserved 09:1011:30 for interviews. Adjacent Family Alcove reserved for caregiver with a pack-n-play and a low table. Stroller route taped and cleared from Lobby to 4th floor elevator. Low-scent cleaning applied.

Security Desk: Visitor badge printed under "Maya Chen"; caregiver badge printed under "Caregiver - Chen". Please present ID at check-in. If driving, one-day P2 permit available; otherwise valet not required. We'll escort them to Quiet Room F. Badge desk staffed by Leo 09:0012:00.

Cafe Team: Vegetarian boxed snack + bottled water confirmed for candidate and caregiver at 09:20. Kid-friendly fruit cup provided in separate packaging (no nuts). Low-fragrance packaging set.

Kelsey Ortiz: Run-of-day (short):
```
09:25  Candidate arrival / badge check (Security)
09:35  Brief intro + systems check (10m)
09:45  Panel interviews start (2x35m with 5m between)
10:50  Wrap + Qs (10m)
11:00  Candidate departs for pickup / debrief notes
```
Zoom fallback: https://zoom.redwood-inc/room-fallback (use if running late)

Priya Menon: Facilities  please confirm pack-n-play set up time and that Family Alcove has a small blanket and a white-noise device. Security  text me when both badges are printed. I'll DM Maya the calendar invite and pickup instructions.

Facilities Bot: Pack-n-play delivered to Family Alcove by 09:05. Blanket and white-noise device placed. Baby changing mat available in restroom on 4th floor.

Security Desk: Will SMS Priya at badge print and at escort to Quiet Room F. P2 permit ready if needed.

Kelsey Ortiz: Thanks team  I'll add a note to the interviewers to keep the schedule tight and flag the early end. Priya, I'll stand by to help with check-out if debrief runs long. :thumbsup:
